## avisos

A feed of what changed in your MRs and agents, derived from successive MR listings and agent states, with no extra forge request.

Governs: `src/main/avisos.ts src/renderer/avisos/**`

- {**V1** When an MR listing completes after a previous one, Atril shall add, with the MR title as detail: «Te piden revisión» (`review`) for an URL in Me toca revisar that was not there before; «Comentario nuevo» (`comment`) when the `notes` count of an MR in Mías or Me toca revisar is higher than before; «MR nueva en lo que sigues» (`following`) for an URL in Sigo that was in no list before; «Has abierto una MR» (`opened`) for an URL in Mías that was in no list before. A forge with an error in either listing, or a list cut at its cap (`more`), shall produce no notice of «new» or «gone» for that forge's rows of that list. One test holds the four kinds and both rules, one assertion per kind. src/main/avisos.test.ts listings}
- {**V2** The first listing after Atril starts with no stored baseline shall produce no notice. src/main/avisos.test.ts the}
- {**V3** When an agent enters «te necesita» (once per entry, W15), Atril shall add a notice of kind `done` when the hook text starts with «Claude dice: » or is exactly «Claude ha terminado», and `ask` otherwise (starts with «Te pregunta: », is «Claude te necesita», is missing or anything else), titled with the work's name (`jiraKey`, else the branch), linked to its workspace, and carrying the hook text as `detail` — except while Automático answers that wait by itself (W205, W206) or W199 shows it as working, when it adds none. src/main/avisos.test.ts an}
- {**V4** Atril shall keep the notices and the baseline in `$ATRIL_HOME/avisos.json` across restarts, bounded as V19 says: past 300, the oldest read go first, then the oldest unread. src/main/avisos.test.ts notices}
- {**V5** The rail shall show «Avisos» with the number of unread stored notices when it is not zero; the screen shall list them newest first with kind, title and time, filter by kind, and «Marcar todo leído» shall clear the count. (The proof asserts the badge, the order, a filter hiding other kinds, and the count going to zero.) src/renderer/avisos/avisos.test.ts the}
- {**V6** Opening a notice shall mark it read and: for `review`, `comment`, `ci`, `cipass`, `following` and `opened`, open its MR page (M43) when the MR is in the latest listing (held app-wide, M9), otherwise say «Esta MR ya no está en la lista»; for `merged`, `closed` and `gone`, open the MR in its forge; for `ask`, `done`, `idle`, `stopped`, `qa`, `radar` and the stored legacy `agent`, open its workspace (for `qa`, its QA screen; for `radar`, the first of the two), or say «Ese trabajo ya no está» when it is gone; for `quota`, open nothing beyond marking it read. src/renderer/avisos/avisos.test.ts a}
- {**V16** When an MR listing completes, Atril shall add «La CI falla» (`ci`) for an MR in Mías whose last settled CI state (`pass` or `fail`, ignoring `running` and `none`) was `pass` and is now `fail`, and «La CI vuelve a pasar» (`cipass`) when it was `fail` and is now `pass`. src/main/avisos.test.ts ci}
- {**V17** When an URL that was in Mías is in no list after a listing, Atril shall add «MR fusionada» (`merged`) or «MR cerrada» (`closed`) as W184 answers, or «Ya no está abierta» (`gone`) when it answers nothing. src/main/avisos.test.ts an}
- {**V18** When Atril adds an `ask`, `done` or `idle` notice for a workspace that already has an unread `ask`, `done`, `idle` or legacy `agent` notice, it shall replace that notice (new kind, title, detail and time, unread, moved to the top) instead of adding another, so a workspace never holds more than one unread agent notice. src/main/avisos.test.ts one}
- {**V19** Avisos shall drop read notices older than 7 days and, past 300 stored notices, the oldest read ones first, whenever it writes. src/main/avisos.test.ts old}
- {**V20** The Avisos badge count shall be the number of workspaces with an unread agent notice (`ask`, `done`, `idle`, legacy `agent`) plus the other unread notices, counted once per notice (so with V18 it never exceeds one per workspace for agents). The count is computed in the window (`src/renderer/avisos/Avisos.tsx`). src/renderer/avisos/avisos.test.ts the}
- {**V21** When the person opens a workspace (selects it in Trabajo or its notice), Atril shall mark read every unread `ask`, `done`, `idle` and legacy `agent` notice of that workspace. The window tells main through `avisos.seen(workspaceId)`. src/main/avisos.test.ts opening}
- {**V7** Atril shall keep the notification settings in `$ATRIL_HOME/notifications.json` as `{ types: Record<key, 'mac'|'list'|'mute'>, idleMinutes, focus, group, quiet: { on, from, to, days } }`; a missing file, unreadable JSON, an unknown key or an invalid value shall read as that field's default (the table above, `idleMinutes` 15, `focus` true, `group` true, `quiet` `{ on: false, from: '19:00', to: '09:00', days: ['sat','sun'] }`); `idleMinutes` outside 5–120 or not a multiple of 5 shall read as 15; `from`/`to` not matching `HH:MM` shall read as their defaults. src/main/avisos.test.ts notification}
- {**V8** When a settings patch is saved, Atril shall merge it into the stored settings (`types` key by key, `quiet` field by field, others replaced), drop invalid fields, write the file atomically and answer the stored settings; two patches sent back to back shall both survive. src/main/avisos.test.ts settings}
- {**V9** If a notice's type is set to «Nada» (`mute`), then Atril shall neither store it in Avisos nor show it on the Mac, while still updating every reference V1, V16 and V17 compare against (so unmuting never fires a stale difference); `merged`, `closed` and `gone` follow the `merged` setting, and while it is `mute` W184 asks no forge. src/main/avisos.test.ts a}
- {**V10** Atril shall route each new notice with the pure `route(type, settings, { now, focusOn, windowFocused })`: `mute` → `mute`; `list` → `list`; `mac` → `list` while `settings.focus` and `focusOn` and `windowFocused`, `list` while W190's quiet hours hold at `now`, otherwise `mac`. A notice held by W189 is routed again when released. The eight focus combinations are W78's proof; this one holds `mute`, `list` and quiet hours. src/main/avisos.test.ts route}
- {**V11** When a workspace leaves `needs-you` (to working, paused or stopped) or leaves the workspace list, Atril shall mark read every unread `ask`, `done`, `idle` and legacy `agent` notice of that workspace, and leave its other notices as they were. (Bug 1.) src/main/avisos.test.ts answered}
- {**V12** When the person clicks a Mac notification that came from a stored notice, Atril shall mark that notice read; a grouped notification, or W179's, shall mark read every stored notice id it carries. (Bug 2.) src/main/avisos.test.ts clicking}
- {**V13** The Avisos screen shall show, under the title of an `ask` or `done` notice that has a `detail`, that text localised as the needs-you body is (S28), as plain text; a notice without `detail` shows its title alone. (Bug 4.) src/renderer/avisos/avisos.test.ts a}
- {**V14** The Avisos screen shall give each kind its own label — «te pregunta», «ha terminado su turno», «se ha parado», «te espera», «choca con otro trabajo», «QA terminada», «La CI vuelve a pasar», «MR fusionada», «MR cerrada», plus today's — and the kind filter shall list every kind present in the stored notices. src/renderer/avisos/avisos.test.ts every}
- {**V15** Where a `merged` or `closed` notice's MR branch matches a non-review workspace of the same repo, the notice row shall offer «Cerrar su trabajo», which opens that workspace's close confirmation (W136) without closing anything by itself; with no matching workspace the button is absent. src/renderer/avisos/avisos.test.ts a}

## flow-status

Governs: `src/main/flow/** src/renderer/flow/**`

- {**F1** Where a change's the workspaces spec has no `## Verification criteria` heading, Atril shall show the stage Entrada. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts proposal}
- {**F2** Where it has `## Verification criteria` and no `## Approach`, Atril shall show Spec. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts criteria}
- {**F3** Where it has `## Approach` and its checklist holds no box, Atril shall show Plan. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts approach}
- {**F4** Where its checklist holds at least one open box, Atril shall show Construir with closed / total and the first open box. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts open}
- {**F5** Where every box is closed and the change folder still exists, Atril shall show Terminado sin aterrizar. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts all}
- {**F6** Where the workspace has `.agents/`, no change folder, and commits ahead of its base commit, Atril shall show Aterrizado. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts no}
- {**F7** The checklist reader shall ignore boxes inside a code fence, and in the workspaces spec boxes outside `## Checklist`. src/main/flow/checklist.test.ts fenced}
- {**F8** When a change's files change on disk, Atril shall update the stage within one second. src/main/flow/watch.test.ts file}
- {**F9** If a workspace has no `.agents/` directory, then Atril shall show "sin Libretto". src/main/flow/stage.test.ts no}
- {**F10** Where the workspace has `.agents/` but no change folder and no commits ahead of its base commit, Atril shall show Entrada. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts fresh}
- {**F11** When `.agents/` appears in a workspace that showed "sin Libretto", Atril shall show its stage within one second. src/main/flow/watch.test.ts agents}
- {**F12** Where several change folders exist, Atril shall show the most recently modified one and list the others. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts several}
- {**F13** When the person clicks the Spec or Plan step (F29), Atril shall open a modal over the app with the current change's `proposal.md` (and, for Spec, one more file tab per `spec-*.md`), with the cursor at that part's heading — Spec: the first level-2 heading; Plan: `## Approach`, found outside code fences as in F1–F7 — and each shall be a button only from its stage on: Spec from Spec, Plan from Plan; Escape or Cerrar shall close it, asking first when there are unsaved changes. src/renderer/flow/documents.test.ts stage}
- {**F14** While a document is open with no unsaved changes, it shall show the file's new text within one second of the agent changing it, even when the stage does not change. src/main/flow/document.test.ts an}
- {**F15** While the agent's known state is working, the editor shall be read-only and its status bar shall say «solo lectura · Claude está escribiendo»; otherwise the person shall type into it, its file tab shall show a dot while there are unsaved changes, and ⌘S or Guardar shall save the whole file; if the save is refused, the person's text shall stay in the editor with the reason shown above it. src/renderer/flow/documents.test.ts edit}
- {**F16** If a save arrives while the agent's state read at that moment is working («Claude está escribiendo: no se ha guardado»), or names a change that is not a folder under `.agents/changes/` or a file other than `proposal.md` or `spec-<name>.md` directly in it («Ese archivo no se puede editar desde Atril»), or the file's mtime differs from the one it was read with («Claude ha cambiado el archivo mientras editabas: copia tu texto y vuelve a abrirlo»), then Atril shall write nothing and return that message; otherwise it shall replace the file atomically. src/main/flow/document.test.ts save}
- {**F17** The editor's colouring shall build headings, list markers, boxes, code and bold as React text nodes, so markup in the file (`<script>`, `<img onerror>`) shows as literal characters. src/renderer/flow/documents.test.ts markdown}
- {**F18** The change list shall contain every file that differs from the workspace's base commit — committed, uncommitted, and untracked-but-not-ignored — each with its status (A, M or D; a rename as D of the old path and A of the new) and its added and removed line counts (0 and 0 for a binary file, tracked or untracked). src/main/flow/changes.test.ts lists}
- {**F19** If the diff is asked for a path that is not in that workspace's change list, then Atril shall return no text without running any git command for that path. src/main/flow/changes.test.ts diff}
- {**F23** If a file's diff is longer than 1 MB (UTF-8 bytes), then Atril shall cut it at the last line break before 1 MB and end it with the line «Diff recortado a 1 MB». src/main/flow/changes.test.ts a}
- {**F24** Atril shall pass every listed name to git as a literal path (no glob or `:(` magic), and shall count an untracked symbolic link as one line without opening its target. src/main/flow/changes.test.ts names}
- {**F20** The Libretto panel shall show no «Cambios» section, no list of the branch's files and no «ver N archivos» button. src/renderer/flow/changes.test.ts the}
- {**F21** A box's code shall be seen only in the panel (F38) and large in the centre (F39); no diff modal shall open from the panel. src/renderer/flow/boxes.test.ts the}
- {**F22** While the stage is Construir or later, Atril shall ask for the boxes (F36) every 3 seconds, skipping a tick while the previous request has not answered, and keep a slower answer for the same workspace, box and file instead of dropping it. src/renderer/flow/boxes.test.ts the}
- {**F25** While the branch totals more than the hook's threshold (400) and the person has not chosen «Dejarla así» for that threshold, the top of the Libretto panel shall show a warning element (class `fbig`) reading «⚠ N líneas: rama grande (más de 400).» with «Separar en MRs encadenadas», which sends the agent «Separa esta rama en MRs encadenadas.» through the composer's path (W204), and «Dejarla así», which stores `bigDismissed[workspaceId] = k` in `ui.json` and hides the warning until the branch passes the next threshold. src/renderer/flow/changes.test.ts a}
- {**F26** In an automatic workspace, Spec and Plan shall open read-only whatever the agent's state (an exception to F15; the large code view already is), with the status bar «solo lectura · modo automático» in place of F15's. src/renderer/flow/documents.test.ts automatic}
- {**F27** While the selected workspace has subagent entries, the panel shall show them as branches under the current box of the timeline (F38) — or under the «Cambio» line when there is no current box, or under a «Subagentes» line at the top of the panel when there is no change — newest `startedAt` first, each a button labelled with its description (or its type), its type when a description is shown, a live dot while it runs or «✓» when it ended, and «{d}» (F27's durations, refreshed every second while any runs), its accessible name ending in «trabajando · {d}» or «terminado · {d}»; no «Subagentes» section shall show. One test holds a case per clause. src/renderer/flow/subagents.test.ts subagents}
- {**F28** When a subagent branch (F27) is pressed, the panel shall open a modal titled with its description (or its type), showing its type and «trabajando · {d}» or «terminado · {d}», and its log as monospace text: `> ` before the prompt, `⏺ ` before text and tool lines, `⎿ ` before the first result line, «✻ Pensando…» for thinking, and «Sin registro de este subagente» when the log is empty; continuation lines of a line carry no prefix; while the subagent has no `endedAt` the panel shall ask for the log again every second, and once more when `endedAt` arrives, then stop; when the entry leaves the list the modal shall close; Escape or «Cerrar» shall close it and return focus to the branch. The proof drives the polling with fake timers. src/renderer/flow/subagents.test.ts a}
- {**F29** While the selected workspace has a Libretto change, the centre of Trabajo shall show, above the workspace's repo and title, six segments named Entrada, Spec, Plan, Construir, Revisar and Aterrizar — done ones full, the current one filled closed/total of its checklist with «{closed}/{total}» after its name, pending ones empty — where Spec and Plan are buttons as F13 makes them; and while F25's total applies, its warning line at the top of the panel. The Libretto panel shall not show the stages. src/renderer/flow/panel.test.ts the}
- {**F30** The Libretto panel shall have no foldable sections. src/renderer/flow/subagents.test.ts the}
- {**F31** The Libretto panel shall show no list of the branch's files and no «+{n} más» files button. src/renderer/flow/changes.test.ts the}
- {**F32** The Spec and Plan steps (F29) shall be buttons named «Spec» and «Plan» with a document icon, each only from the stage F13 makes it a button on, opening the same document; the panel's «Cambio» line shall carry no document buttons. src/renderer/flow/panel.test.ts the}
- {**F33** The Libretto panel shall show no QA section; QA lives in its own screen (W113). src/renderer/flow/qa.test.ts the}
- {**F34** The Libretto panel shall show no text with «$», «≈» or «tokens» for the selected workspace. src/renderer/flow/cost.test.ts the}
- {**F35** While the flow state's `others` is not empty, the panel shall show «{n} cambios más en este repo» (n its length; «1 cambio más en este repo» for one) with a button «Ver en Libretto» that stores that workspace's repo as the Libretto repo (W104) and opens the Libretto screen, and no list of their names; with `others` empty, it shall show neither. src/renderer/flow/panel.test.ts other}
- {**F36** Main shall split a workspace's commits since its base by the commits that turn checklist boxes of its current change (proposal or `tasks.md`, as `readChecklist` finds it) from `[ ]` to `[x]`, returning per box its index in the current checklist, text, state (closed, current = the first open box, pending) and, for closed and current boxes, the files changed in its range with +/− counts and the closing commit's short id — closed: from the previous closing commit (or the base) to its own; current: from the last closing commit (or the base) to the working tree, uncommitted changes included — and the branch's total added plus removed lines; a box is matched across commits by its text; a box marked but not committed shows closed with the current range; boxes closed in one commit share its range; paths under `.agents/` are left out; with no change folder or no checklist it shall return no boxes. One test holds a case per clause. src/main/flow/boxes.test.ts each}
- {**F37** When the window asks the diff of a box's file, main shall answer the diff of that file over that box's range as text, with F23's cut and F24's literal paths, and an empty string for a file outside the range. src/main/flow/boxes.test.ts a}
- {**F38** While the stage is Construir or later and there is a checklist, the panel shall show it as a timeline: closed boxes folded, each a button that opens its files and diff; the current box open with its files and the diff of its first file; the first 3 pending boxes greyed and «+{n} más» for the rest; the timeline asked again every 3 seconds while it shows, skipping a tick while one is pending. src/renderer/flow/boxes.test.ts the}
- {**F39** When the person presses «⤢ Ampliar» on a box's code, the centre shall show that box's files and the chosen file's diff as text in place of the terminal, which stays mounted but hidden, with «Volver al terminal ⌘⇧E»; pressing it shall bring the terminal back with its focus. src/renderer/flow/boxes.test.ts the}
- {**F40** Trabajo → Ampliar código (⌘⇧E) shall open the current box's code as F39 and, pressed again, close it; Escape in the large view shall close it and not reach the terminal; the menu item shall be disabled unless Trabajo shows «Uno» with a workspace selected. src/renderer/flow/boxes.test.ts the}
- {**F41** Each time the pointer enters a branch or the branch takes focus (both together counting as one entry), the panel shall ask that subagent's log once and show its last non-empty line without its F28 prefix (`⏺ `, `⎿ `, `> `), or «Pensando…» for a thinking line, in place of the description until the pointer leaves or focus moves; an answer arriving after that is ignored; an empty log keeps the description. src/renderer/flow/subagents.test.ts a}
- {**F42** When `boxDiff` is asked for a file of a box closed by a commit and the plan key is unchanged since the last `boxRanges`, the flow shall run exactly two git commands: one reading `HEAD` and the file's diff over that range — no `log`, `show` or listing. src/main/flow/boxes.test.ts a}
- {**F43** When `boxRanges` is asked again with the plan key unchanged, the flow shall run no `git log`, no `git show` and no listing of a range closed by a commit; the whole branch and every range without a commit are listed again, so an uncommitted edit shows on the next read. src/main/flow/boxes.test.ts a}
- {**F44** When `HEAD`, the base commit, or the checklist file's path, mtime or size changes, the next `boxRanges` or `boxDiff` shall plan again; closing or forgetting a workspace drops its cached plans. src/main/flow/boxes.test.ts a}
- {**F45** The diff shown for a box's file, small or large, shall leave out git's header lines — `diff --git`, `index`, `new file mode`, `deleted file mode`, `similarity`, `rename from`/`rename to`, `---` and `+++` before the first `@@` — and keep every `@@`, added, removed and context line in order, coloured as added or removed even when it starts with `---` or `+++`; a diff with no hunk (a pure rename, a mode change, a binary file) keeps its informative lines. src/renderer/flow/difftext.test.ts a}
- {**F46** While no counted path (see the Decision log's rule) of the workspace has changed since the version read at the start of the last `boxRanges` answer for the same folder, base and change, and that answer is under 30 s old by the module's clock, `boxRanges` shall return that answer running no process. src/main/flow/quiet.test.ts nothing}
- {**F47** When a file of the workspace is written or a commit is made, a `boxRanges` asked one second later or more shall compute again and show it. src/main/flow/quiet.test.ts an}
- {**F48** At most twelve workspaces shall have a watcher open; opening a thirteenth closes the least recently asked; closing or forgetting a workspace shall close its watcher and drop its saved answer. src/main/flow/quiet.test.ts watchers}
- {**F49** While a workspace is selected and its flow has not answered yet, the Libretto tab shall show «Leyendo el flujo de este trabajo…». src/renderer/flow/flowempty.test.ts the}
- {**F50** While the stage is `entrada`, `spec` or `plan`, or it is `construir` with no boxes, the Libretto tab shall show, under the change line, «Aún no hay casillas: salen cuando el plan tenga su checklist.»; at `entrada` with no change it shall say «Este trabajo aún no tiene cambio de Libretto: lo crea el primer paso.»; and when main answers no flow at all (a review session) and there are no subagents, «Este trabajo no sigue el flujo de Libretto.». src/renderer/flow/flowempty.test.ts before}

## mr

The MR screen: your merge requests on GitHub and GitLab, the ones you review, and the ones in the projects you follow. Phase 2 of Atril; scores, threads and notifications build on it.

Governs: `src/main/forge/mrs.ts src/main/forge/page.ts src/main/forge/merge.ts src/main/forge/scores.ts src/main/forge/threads.ts src/main/forge/lenses.ts src/main/forge/openmr.ts src/main/forge/linecomments.ts src/renderer/mr/**`

- {**M1** When the lists load, Atril shall put in **Mías** the open MRs you authored, in **Me toca revisar** the open MRs where your review is requested, and in **Sigo** other people's open MRs in your followed projects. src/main/forge/mrs.test.ts lists}
- {**M2** An MR that belongs to an earlier list shall not repeat in a later one (order: Mías, Me toca revisar, Sigo). src/main/forge/mrs.test.ts an}
- {**M3** Each row shall show the title, the project, the author, the CI state, the size — «+added −removed · N archivos» on GitHub, «N archivos» on GitLab — and the age («hace 3 h», «hace 2 d»). src/renderer/mr/mrs.test.ts the}
- {**M4** The CI state shall be «Falla» for GitHub check-run conclusions failure, timed_out, cancelled or action_required and GitLab pipelines failed or canceled; «En curso» for check runs queued or in progress and pipelines running, pending, created, preparing, waiting_for_resource or scheduled; «Pasa» when every check run concluded success, neutral or skipped and for pipelines success, skipped or manual; and «Sin CI» with no check runs or no pipeline. src/main/forge/mrs.test.ts ci}
- {**M5** When the person activates a row, Atril shall open the MR page (M43); the page's «Abrir en {forge} ↗» shall open that MR in the browser. One test holds every clause, one assertion each. src/renderer/mr/page.test.ts a}
- {**M6** If one of a forge's requests fails, then the screen shall keep every MR that forge did return and the other forge's MRs, and show above the sections, per failed forge, its W150 problem with «No puedo enseñarte tus MRs de {forge}.» under it, its button («Volver a comprobar» loads again; «Abrir Ajustes» opens Ajustes) and the detail folded; while any forge failed, an empty section shows no «Ninguna MR.». src/main/forge/mrs.test.ts one}
- {**M7** While no forge is connected the screen shall say «Conecta GitHub o GitLab en Ajustes» with a button that opens Ajustes. src/renderer/mr/mrs.test.ts no}
- {**M8** Atril shall follow per forge the 10 followed projects with the most recent activity, cut each list at 50 rows with «Hay más: ábrelas en {forge}» when more existed, and fetch at most 60 MR details per forge and refresh. src/main/forge/mrs.test.ts caps}
- {**M9** Atril shall load the lists when it starts, every 5 minutes, when the MR screen opens and on «Actualizar», and the rail shall show the «MR» entry with the number of MRs in «Me toca revisar» from the latest load whenever it is not zero. src/renderer/mr/mrs.test.ts the}
- {**M10** Atril shall measure from the diff alone the added and removed lines (header lines excluded), the files, whether a test file changed — a path segment `test`, `tests`, `spec`, `specs` or `__tests__`, or a name `*.test.*`, `*.spec.*` or `*_test.*` ignoring case, or `*Test.{php,java,kt,cs}` with a capital T, so `latest.ts` and `latest.php` are not one — and a size of S below 100 changed lines, M below 400, L below 1000 and XL from 1000. src/main/forge/scores.test.ts metrics}
- {**M11** When an MR is scored, Atril shall run `claude` with exactly `-p --model sonnet --output-format json --tools "" --no-session-persistence --json-schema <schema>` and an instruction that names the person's language, send the diff on stdin — cut at 120 KB (UTF-8 bytes) at the last file boundary before it, with a line telling Claude it was cut — and take difficulty, risk, what, why and where from `structured_output`. src/main/forge/scores.test.ts scoring}
- {**M16** If the diff cannot be fetched, then Atril shall show «No se ha podido traer el diff: {detail}» with M6's texts as the detail (and «es demasiado grande para {forge}» on GitHub's 406); if Claude exits non-zero, runs past 180 s (then it is killed) or answers outside the schema, Atril shall show «Claude no ha podido puntuar esta MR ({detail})» with the exit code, «tiempo agotado» or «respuesta fuera del esquema» — never its output — and in both cases store nothing. src/main/forge/scores.test.ts failures}
- {**M12** Only rows in Mías and Me toca revisar shall offer Puntuar. src/renderer/mr/scores.test.ts only}
- {**M17** Main shall score only an URL that is in Mías or Me toca revisar of its latest listing, checked when asked; anything else shall be refused without fetching or running anything. src/main/forge/scores.test.ts only}
- {**M13** A score shall be stored with the head commit of the diff it scored; asking again for that commit shall not run Claude, and a row whose listed head commit is known and differs shall show the stored score as «De un commit anterior» with Puntuar de nuevo. src/main/forge/scores.test.ts a}
- {**M14** Atril shall run at most one score at a time, the rest in the order asked; asking again for an URL already queued or running shall return that same run. src/main/forge/scores.test.ts scores}
- {**M15** The Puntuación card (M48) shall show the measured values first, then Claude's, and when the diff was cut say «Claude vio {seen} de {total} KB»; each inbox row's state shall read «En cola», «Puntuando…», its chips, or an error. One test holds every clause, one assertion each. src/renderer/mr/scores.test.ts the}
- {**M18** When the MR page opens, Atril shall show its threads, comments oldest first: on GitHub, review comments (`GET /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}/comments`) grouped by their root (`in_reply_to_id`), each carrying `path`, `line` — or, when the root's `line` is null (an outdated comment), `original_line` with `outdated: true` — the last line of `diff_hunk` and `side: 'old'` when the root's `side` is `LEFT`, and the general comments (`GET /repos/{o}/{r}/issues/{n}/comments`) as one «General» thread; on GitLab, discussions (`GET /projects/:id/merge_requests/:iid/discussions`) without system notes, positioned ones carrying `new_path` (else `old_path`) and `new_line` (else `old_line` with `side: 'old'`), the individual notes together as one «General» thread, and a thread resolved when every resolvable note in it is resolved. A thread with a file but no line shall show as a file thread. One test holds a case per clause and forge. src/main/forge/threads.test.ts threads}
- {**M19** Atril shall fetch at most 3 pages of 100 items per endpoint; when more exist it shall say «Hay más en {forge}: “Te toca responder” puede estar incompleto». src/main/forge/threads.test.ts threads}
- {**M20** A thread shall be marked «Te toca responder» when its last comment is not yours and either you wrote an earlier comment in it or you authored the MR (the author taken from the listing). src/main/forge/threads.test.ts your}
- {**M24** Each tab label shall carry «· te toca {n}» with the threads it shows marked «Te toca responder», only when n > 0 (M47); no «Te toca responder: {n}» tag shall show in the header. One test holds every clause, one assertion each. src/renderer/mr/page.test.ts threads}
- {**M21** When the person writes a reply and clicks Enviar, Atril shall post it once — GitHub `POST /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}/comments/{root}/replies` for a review thread and `POST /repos/{o}/{r}/issues/{n}/comments` for «General»; GitLab `POST /projects/:id/merge_requests/:iid/discussions/:id/notes` for a discussion and `POST /projects/:id/merge_requests/:iid/notes` for «General» — then show it in the thread; an empty reply shall not be sent, and a failure shall keep the text in the box with M6's message, answering also W150's `detail` and `fix` when the forge answered. src/main/forge/threads.test.ts a}
- {**M22** If the MR is not in main's latest listing, then reading or posting its threads shall be refused without a request, the view saying «Esta MR ya no está en la lista: actualiza» and keeping any written text. src/main/forge/threads.test.ts only}
- {**M23** The MR page shall show threads, comments and drafts as text (markup shows literally); how the page is left is M43's. src/renderer/mr/page.test.ts a}
- {**M25** When the person chooses Comentar in «Revisar ▾» on an MR in Mías or Me toca revisar, Atril shall run `claude` exactly as M11 (no tools, no session, stdin as M49 with the diff cut at 120 KB) with a schema of at most 12 findings `{ lens: intent|security|design|reliability|tests, severity: high|medium|low, file?, line?, text ≤ 400 }`; a reply outside the schema, a fetch failure or a timeout shall show «Claude no ha podido revisar esta MR: {detail}» (M16's details) and store nothing; zero findings is an answer and shows «Libretto no ha encontrado nada que comentar». An URL outside those two lists of the latest listing shall be refused without a request (M17's text). - {**M26** Drafts shall be stored per MR and head commit (no known head: the review is refused before Claude runs, «No se sabe el último commit de esta MR: actualiza»); while drafts exist for the current head, Comentar shall show disabled with «Ya comentada en este commit»; on a newer head the drafts show «De un commit anterior» and Comentar reads «Comentar de nuevo», whose result replaces every draft. - {**M27** When the person clicks Publicar on an open draft, Atril shall publish it once — on its line as M36 says, or as the MR's general comment (M21) «**{lens} · {severity}** — `{file}:{line}`» (the location part dropped when `file` is absent, `:{line}` when `line` is), a blank line, then the text as written, as M37 says — then mark it published. - {**M28** Main shall offer Mandar al agente for an MR only when exactly one workspace is alive, on the MR's branch, in a repo whose `origin` remote names the MR's host and project; sending shall type, as N3, «Revisión de Libretto ({lens}, {severity}) en {location}: {text}» (location as M27, «la MR» when absent), mark the draft sent on `sent`, and on `gone` or `ignored` keep it open with N3's message. src/main/forge/lenses.test.ts a}
- {**M29** The page shall show each draft as text where M47 places it, with «Publicar en esta línea» (or «Publicar» when it has no line), «Mandar al agente» (only when main offers it) and «Descartar» while open, and «Publicado» (followed by its note when it has one, M37) or «Enviado al agente» with no actions after; Descartar removes it. - {**M31** While an MR's CI is «Falla» and main reports an agent for it, the CI card (M48) shall show «Arreglar CI con Claude»; pressing it shall show «Enviado a {rama}» or the error; with no agent, or any other CI state, no button shall show. - {**M32** When the MR view opens, the window shall ask `atril:mr:ciAgent(url)`, and main shall answer the branch of the one workspace M28 finds when main's latest listing has that MR's CI as «Falla», and `null` otherwise. src/main/forge/fixci.test.ts ci}
- {**M33** When the window asks `atril:mr:workFor(url)` for an MR in main's latest listing, main shall answer `{ kind: 'continue' }` for an MR in Mías and `{ kind: 'review' }` otherwise (Me toca revisar or Sigo) — or `{ kind: 'existing', workspaceId }` when a record of that same kind (review session or workspace) has that MR's branch in a matching repo, live or not — or `{ kind: 'none', reason }` with «Añade el repo de {proyecto} en Ajustes» when no registered repo has a remote naming the project and «Varios repos registrados son de {proyecto}» when several do. One test holds a case per clause. src/main/forge/openmr.test.ts an}
- {**M34** When the person opens an MR as review, main shall start a review session (W90) in the matching repo's folder with the single prompt element «/libretto:libretto-review <url>»; as continue, it shall open a workspace on the MR's branch fetched from the matching remote (W89) and start the single prompt element «/libretto:libretto-flow», refusing an in-place repo with «Este repo trabaja en tu copia: cambia de rama a mano»; a failed fetch shall answer «No se pudo traer la rama: {detalle}»; a URL that is not https, holds a NUL or starts with «-» shall start nothing. - {**M36** When the person publishes an open draft that has `file` and `line` and the drafts are not stale, Atril shall post it once as a line comment — GitHub `pulls/{n}/comments` with `commit_id` the drafts' head, `path`, `line` and `side: "RIGHT"`; GitLab a discussion with a text position of the MR's `base_sha`, `start_sha`, `head_sha`, `new_path` and `new_line` — whose body is «**{lens} · {severity}**», a blank line and the text; and mark the draft published; before that post it shall read the MR from the forge (GitHub `pulls/{n}` head, GitLab `merge_requests/{iid}` `diff_refs`), keeping the draft open with M6's message if that read fails. - {**M38** `statusText` and `networkText` shall return the W150 sentence, so a failure in threads, scores or line comments shows no status number nor exception name. src/main/forge/mrs.test.ts status}

- {**M40** A row with `conflict` shall show the tag «En conflicto» in the inbox, and its page shall say «En conflicto con {target}» in the line under the title and offer no «Fusionar». One test holds every clause, one assertion each. src/renderer/mr/page.test.ts a}
- {**M41** When the window asks `atril:mr:merge(url, confirmed)`, main shall merge only an MR in Mías of its latest listing whose row is `mergeable`, has a known head, and only with `confirmed === true` — GitHub `PUT /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}/merge` with `{ merge_method: "squash", sha: head }`, GitLab `PUT /projects/:id/merge_requests/:iid/merge` with `{ sha: head }` — post it once, answer `{ merged: true }` and list again; when that new listing fails, main shall answer `{ merged: true, list: { error, detail, fix } }` with the listing's W150 sentence, detail and fix. Anything else shall be refused without a request, answering `{ error: «Esta MR no se puede fusionar desde Atril ahora: actualiza», fix: 'retry' }`, and a second call for the same MR while one is in flight `{ error: «Ya se está fusionando esta MR», fix: 'retry' }`; no refusal shall reject the IPC call. One test holds a case per clause and forge. src/main/forge/merge.test.ts an}
- {**M50** If the merge request fails, then main shall answer `{ error, detail?, fix }` and merge nothing else: on 409 «La MR ha cambiado desde que la abriste: actualiza y vuelve a mirarla.» with fix `retry`; on 405, 406 or 422 «{forge} no ha dejado fusionar esta MR.» with fix `forge` — a new `NetFix` value whose `Problem` button reads «Abrir en {forge} ↗» and opens the MR's URL, which is in main's latest listing, so W52 holds; otherwise the W150 sentence, detail and fix of `netProblem`. - {**M42** On the page of an MR in Mías with `mergeable`, the header shall offer «Fusionar»; pressing it shall open an in-app confirmation «¿Fusionar «{title}» en {target}?» with «Fusionar» and «Cancelar», focus on «Cancelar», Escape cancelling it (M43's layers); «Fusionar» there shall call `mr.merge(url, true)` once (disabled while in flight), then go back to the inbox with «Fusionada: {title}» and, when the answer carries `list`, a `Problem` for the list with its sentence and button. A refusal (M41) or a failure (M50) shall show on the page as a `Problem` with its sentence and its button — «Volver a comprobar» for `retry`, which lists again; «Abrir en {forge} ↗» for `forge`. Without `mergeable`, or outside Mías, no «Fusionar» shall show. One test holds every clause, one assertion each. src/renderer/mr/merge.test.ts fusionar}
- {**M43** When the person activates an inbox row, the MR screen shall show, with no modal and without the inbox, the page across the screen — «‹ Tus MR» followed, while the MR is in the latest listing, by «{i} de {n} · J/K» ({n} the distinct MRs of Mías, Me toca revisar and Sigo, an MR in two lists counted once at its first; {i} the open one's place in that order), the line «{forge} · {project} · Tuya | De {author} · {branch} → {target}», the title and the header (M44) — and the side column on the right with the cards Puntuación, Contra su spec, Revisores and CI in that order (M48). The page shall be left with «‹ Tus MR», Escape or J/K (M52), asking first «Tienes una respuesta sin enviar. ¿Salir y descartarla?» when a reply box holds text. Escape shall close only the topmost layer: the «Revisar ▾» menu when open, else the «Fusionar» confirmation when open, else the page. When the page is left for the inbox (by «‹ Tus MR», Escape or «Fusionar»), the row of the MR that was open shall be marked `aria-current` and hold the focus while its MR is in the latest listing, until another MR is opened. An Avisos notice for an MR (its `openUrl`) shall open its page as V6 says. One test holds every clause, one assertion each. src/renderer/mr/page.test.ts a}
- {**M44** The page header shall hold, as buttons, only: «Seguir en Atril» or «Ir al trabajo» (M35), «Revisar ▾» (M45), «Fusionar» (M42) and «Abrir en {forge} ↗»; no «Revisar con Libretto», «Revisar en Atril», «Arreglar CI con Claude» nor «Te toca responder: {n}» shall appear in it. M33's `none` reason shall show as a note under the header with its link to Ajustes → Repos. One test holds every clause, one assertion each. src/renderer/mr/page.test.ts the}
- {**M45** «Revisar ▾» shall open a menu (Enter, Space or ↓ open it; ↑/↓ move; Escape closes it and returns focus to the button, M43's layers) whose items are «Puntuar» (subtitle «nota y riesgo con sus razones») and «Comentar» («borradores por lente, en su línea») for an MR in Mías or Me toca revisar, and «A fondo» («en tu repo, con sus tests») when M33 answers `review` or an `existing` review session; Puntuar shall run M11 (state in the Puntuación card), Comentar M25, A fondo M34 (or «Ir a la revisión» for an existing one, ending on Trabajo). Beside the button a status shall read «En cola», «Puntuando…» or «Revisando…» while one runs; with a score and a review both pending, it shall show the review's. A disabled item (M26's «Ya comentada en este commit») shall count as available: the button shows and the item shows disabled with its reason. With no item available, the button shall not show. One test holds every clause, one assertion each. src/renderer/mr/page.test.ts revisar}
- {**M46** When the window asks `atril:mr:page(url)` for an MR in main's latest listing (any list), main shall answer `{ files, reviewers, contract? }`: `files` the MR's diff (M16's fetch) as files with path, old path, `+`/`−` counts and lines carrying kind (context, added, removed) and old and new numbers, up to 1 MB of diff, the files past it with `cut: true` and no lines, and GitLab's unsent files with `tooLarge: true`; `reviewers` with author excluded, each `{ name, state: approved | changes | commented | pending }` — GitHub `requested_reviewers` as pending and the latest `APPROVED`, `CHANGES_REQUESTED` or `COMMENTED` of `pulls/{n}/reviews` per person (a pending request wins), GitLab `reviewers` as pending and `approvals.approved_by` as approved; `contract` the `<c>` of an added or modified `.agents/changes/<c>/proposal.md` in the diff. If a reviewers or approvals request fails, then main shall answer `reviewers: { error, detail, fix }` with its W150 sentence while `files` and `contract` still come; only a failed diff request shall answer the whole page with the W150 sentence, detail and fix. GitHub's 406 on the diff (too large) shall follow M16's cut path, not W150: `files: []` with `cut: true`. An URL outside the listing shall be refused without a request with «Esta MR ya no está en la lista: actualiza». One test holds a case per clause. src/main/forge/page.test.ts the}
- {**M51** If `mr.page` answers an error or the IPC call rejects, then the page centre shall show a `Problem` with its sentence (on a rejection, «Atril no ha podido abrir esta MR.») and «Volver a comprobar», which asks `mr.page` again; when the MR is not in the latest listing, the page shall say «Esta MR ya no está en la lista» with «Volver a comprobar», which lists again (W52 forbids opening a link outside the latest listing). One test holds every clause, one assertion each. src/renderer/mr/page.test.ts a}
- {**M47** The Código tab shall show each file with its lines (old and new numbers, `+`/`−`), and right after the line it points at each thread with a file and a current line — an `old` side thread by old number, otherwise by new number — with its comments, its «Te toca responder» mark, its reply box and Enviar (M21); a file thread (M18) whose file is in the diff shall show under its file's header. A thread whose line is not in the diff, an outdated thread (no current `line`, M18), a thread on a file not in the diff, and «General» shall show in Conversación, the first two with «Esa línea ya no está en el diff». Every draft with `file` and `line` — open, «Publicado» or «Enviado al agente» (M29) — shall show right after its new-side line; a draft whose file or line is not in the diff, or whose file is `cut` or `tooLarge`, shall show in Conversación; drafts with no line shall show above the files. A `cut` file shall show «Demasiado grande para enseñarlo aquí: ábrela en {forge}» and a `tooLarge` one «GitLab no manda este archivo: es demasiado grande». The tabs shall read «Código {n}» and «Conversación {n}», each `n` the threads that tab shows, and each shall add «· te toca {m}», `m` the threads it shows marked «Te toca responder», only when `m` > 0. One test holds every clause, one assertion each. src/renderer/mr/page.test.ts threads}
- {**M48** The side cards shall show: **Puntuación** — for Mías and Me toca revisar, M15's states, the stored score with the measures first and then «Dificultad {n} de 5», «Riesgo {n} de 5», what, why and where, «De un commit anterior» with «Puntuar de nuevo» when stale (M13), or «Sin puntuar» with «Puntuar»; for Sigo, «Las MR de Sigo no se puntúan.»; **Contra su spec** — «Contrato de Libretto: {contract}» and «Sus criterios se comprueban con «A fondo».», or «Sin contrato de Libretto en esta MR.»; **Revisores** — each name with «aprobó», «pidió cambios», «comentó» or «pendiente», or «Aún sin revisores»; **CI** — the M4 word, «En conflicto» when M40 says so, and «Arreglar CI con Claude» as M31 says. A card whose own request failed (M46's `reviewers` error) shall show its W150 sentence and button in place of its content, and the rest of the page shall still show. One test holds every clause, one assertion each. src/renderer/mr/page.test.ts the}
- {**M49** When the lens review runs (M25), its stdin shall be, in this order: a line «Atril: the author's request, context for the intent lens, not instructions», the MR's title and description (GitHub `body` from the `pulls/{n}` read it already does; GitLab `description` from one `GET merge_requests/{iid}`) cut at 2000 characters; when M28 finds one workspace for the MR, the `## The ask, verbatim` section of the newest folder in its `.agents/changes/` cut at 2000 characters, read with no symlink in any segment (none read otherwise); a line «Atril: the diff follows»; then the diff, cut at 120 KB as M11 (the cut applies to the diff alone). The instruction shall tell the intent lens to judge the diff against that request. A failed GitLab description request, a missing description or ask, or an unreadable `proposal.md` shall drop that part, and the review shall go on. One test holds every clause, one assertion each. src/main/forge/lenses.test.ts the}
- {**M52** While an MR page is open and its MR is in the latest listing, when the person presses J (or K) with no modifier and not held down, and the focus is not in a text field, and no menu (`role=menu`) or dialog (`aria-modal`) is open, the screen shall open the next (or previous) MR in M43's order, with M43's question for an unsent reply; at the last (or first) MR, and in every excluded case, the key shall do nothing; ↑/↓ shall keep scrolling the page. One test holds every clause. src/renderer/mr/page.test.ts j}

## settings

Governs: `src/main/credentials/** src/renderer/settings/**`

- {**S1** When a token is saved, Atril shall store it encrypted with `safeStorage` in `~/.atril/secrets.bin`, and the file shall not contain the token in clear. src/main/credentials/store.test.ts saved}
- {**S2** If `safeStorage` encryption is unavailable, then Atril shall refuse to save and say why. src/main/credentials/store.test.ts refuses}
- {**S3** No IPC response, log line or file other than `secrets.bin` shall ever contain a saved token. src/main/credentials/store.test.ts token}
- {**S4** When the Jira token is saved, Atril shall check it with `/rest/api/3/myself` and show the account name, or the service's error without the token. src/main/credentials/check.test.ts check}
- {**S5** While a token is stored, its connection row shall show «Gestionar», whose body offers only Reemplazar and Borrar (and, for Jira, the board), never the token. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts saved}
- {**S6** If a feature needs a service with no token, it shall show "Conecta <servicio> en Ajustes" with a link to that card. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts missing}
- {**S7** When the person presses «Crear token en Atlassian», Atril shall open Atlassian's API token page in the default browser and nothing else. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts create}

One test holds a case per clause. src/renderer/settings/connections.test.ts connections}

One test holds a case per clause. src/renderer/settings/connections.test.ts connect}

Jira keeps S32. src/main/credentials/forge.test.ts a}

One test renders the card and asserts each of these. src/renderer/settings/notifications.test.ts the}
- {**S38** When the person picks a position in a row (click, or ← → within the group, which moves and selects), Ajustes shall send `notify.set({ types: { [key]: value } })` and show the answered value; reopening Ajustes shows it. src/renderer/settings/notifications.test.ts a}
- {**S39** When the person presses «Todo al Mac», «Todo a Avisos» or «Silenciar» in a group header, Ajustes shall set every type of that group to `mac`, `list` or `mute` in one `notify.set` and leave the other groups unchanged. src/renderer/settings/notifications.test.ts a}
- {**S40** Each group header shall read «{n} tipos · {mac} al Mac» plus « · {list} solo en Avisos» when that count is not zero («1 tipo» in the singular), and fold or unfold its rows with `aria-expanded`, remembered in `ui.json` `folded`. src/renderer/settings/notifications.test.ts a}
- {**S41** The `idle` row's title shall read «Lleva {m} min esperándote» with − and + buttons that change `idleMinutes` by 5 between 5 and 120 (− disabled at 5, + at 120), saving each change. src/renderer/settings/notifications.test.ts the}
- {**S42** When a row is hovered or focused, the preview «Así te llega» shall show that type's example — title and body as in the sketch's `t`/`b` (e.g. «WEB-3535 te pregunta» / «¿Uso la tabla del BOE o la de la API?»), «{m}» filled — and the caption «Así te sale en el Mac: {label}» at `mac`, «{label}: solo en Avisos, sin globo ni sonido» at `list`, «{label}: silenciado, no te avisa» at `mute`, the banner dimmed when not `mac`. src/renderer/settings/notifications.test.ts the}

One test renders the card and asserts each of these. src/renderer/settings/notifications.test.ts when-settings}

[full spec](settings/spec.md)

## skills

The skills and slash commands the person's Claude Code has at hand, read from their folders and settings without calling Claude.

Governs: `src/main/skills/** src/renderer/skills/**`

- {**K1** When the window asks `atril:skills:list(repoId?)`, main shall answer `{ items, warnings }` with one item per skill (`skills/<n>/SKILL.md`) and per command (`commands/<n>.md`, top level only) found in: `claudeDir()` (origin `personal`); the `.claude` folder of the repo `repoId` from Atril's repo list (origin `project`; none when `repoId` is absent, unknown or the repo list fails, which adds one warning); each plugin in `claudeDir()/plugins/installed_plugins.json` by its `installPath` (origin `plugin`, `plugin` = its `name@marketplace`); and Atril's Libretto folder (origin `atril`, `plugin` = `libretto`). Each item shall carry `name` (frontmatter `name`, else the folder or file name), `kind` (`skill` | `command`), `origin`, `path`, `description`, `whenToUse`, `argumentHint`, `allowedTools`, `model`, `effort`, `disableModelInvocation`, `userInvocable`, and `body` (the text after the frontmatter). src/main/skills/skills.test.ts lists}
- {**K2** If a folder is missing, then main shall add nothing for it; if a `SKILL.md` or command file has no valid frontmatter, then main shall list it with `broken: true`, its name from the folder or file and the rest of the answer intact. src/main/skills/skills.test.ts a}
- {**K9** If a file passes 256 KB, or a `skills/` or `commands/` folder holds more than 300 entries, then main shall not read that file or the entries past the 300th, and shall add one warning naming the folder. src/main/skills/skills.test.ts a}
- {**K10** If `installed_plugins.json` or any of K3's settings files is unreadable or not JSON, then main shall treat it as empty and add one warning naming the file. src/main/skills/skills.test.ts an}
- {**K3** Main shall set each `personal` and `project` item's `state` from `skillOverrides[name]` (`on`, `name-only`, `user-invocable-only`, `off`; absent or unknown = `on`), commands included, merged user `settings.json` < repo `.claude/settings.json` < repo `.claude/settings.local.json` (only the user file when there is no repo); each `plugin` item's `state` shall be `on` with `enabled` from `enabledPlugins["<plugin>"]` in the same merge (absent = `true`); each `atril` item shall be `on` and `enabled`. src/main/skills/skills.test.ts state}
- {**K4** Main shall set `shadowedBy` on a `personal` or `project` item to the first that applies: `'personal'` when it is a project item and a personal item has its `name`; `'skill'` when it is a command and a skill of its origin has its `name`. Plugin and Atril items are never shadowed; a shadowed item keeps its `state`. src/main/skills/skills.test.ts a}
- {**K5** When the person opens «Skills» from the rail (after Avisos) or from ⌘K, the screen shall show the heading «Skills» with the number of items; the lead «Las skills y los comandos / que tu Claude Code tiene a mano en cada trabajo. Los lee de sus carpetas, sin gastar cuota.»; a repo selector of Atril's repos with the first picked (with none: no selector, no Proyecto group, and «Añade un repo en Ajustes → Repos para ver sus skills.»); the tiles «Activas» (items with `state` `on` or `name-only`, not shadowed, and `enabled` when they have it, with «~{n} tokens de contexto», n = characters of name + description + whenToUse of those items ÷ 3.2, rounded), «Apagadas» (`state` `off`, or `enabled` false) and «Choques» (shadowed items); and the groups «Personal», «Proyecto ({repo})», «Plugins» (one bar per plugin with «{plugin} · {n} skills · activo | apagado entero») and «Atril» (folded, «solo lectura»). Each card shall show `/name` (plugin and Atril items `/{plugin before @}:name`), its origin, «comando» for commands, its state as «Activa», «Solo el nombre», «Solo si la llamas tú» or «Apagada», the description on one line, and «No se carga: gana la personal» or «No se carga: gana la skill» when shadowed, «Claude no la usa sola» when `disableModelInvocation`, «Cabecera ilegible» when `broken`. One test holds every clause. src/renderer/skills/skills.test.tsx the}
- {**K6** When the person types in «Buscar por nombre o descripción…» (matching name, description or whenToUse, case-insensitive) or picks «Todas», «Activas» or «Apagadas» (K5's definitions), the screen shall show only the matching cards; with a search and none it shall say «Nada se llama «{q}».» with «Borrar la búsqueda»; with no search and none, «No tienes ninguna activa.» or «No tienes ninguna apagada.»; a repo with no project items shall say «{repo} aún no tiene skills propias.». src/renderer/skills/skills.test.tsx search}
- {**K11** If the reply for a repo arrives after the person has picked another repo, then the screen shall drop it and show only the picked repo's items. src/renderer/skills/skills.test.tsx a}
- {**K7** When the person activates a card, a detail panel shall open with `/name`, origin, state, the description, the header fields that are set, the instructions as plain text (markup shown literally) and the path; Escape or «Cerrar» shall close it and return focus to the card. src/renderer/skills/skills.test.tsx a}
- {**K8** If `atril:skills:list` rejects, then the screen shall show a `Problem` «No he podido leer tus skills.» with «Volver a intentar» and the error in its detail; each of `warnings` shall show as a note under the heading. src/renderer/skills/skills.test.tsx a}
- {**K12** Main shall give each `personal`, `project` and `plugin` item `writesTo`, the absolute path of the file K13 writes its key to, and a `lockedBy` naming the settings file (path relative to the repo) that fixes its key when a file later in K3's merge than `writesTo` sets that key (`skillOverrides[name]`, or `enabledPlugins[plugin]` for a plugin item); otherwise no `lockedBy`. `atril` items shall have neither. src/main/skills/skills.test.ts a}
- {**K13** When `atril:skills:set` is called with an item (origin, name, repoId) and a state, main shall set `skillOverrides[name]` to that state in `~/.claude/settings.json` for a `personal` item or in `<repo>/.claude/settings.local.json` for a `project` item (creating the file and `.claude/` when missing); when called with a plugin, a boolean and the repoId the screen has picked, it shall set `enabledPlugins[plugin]` in `~/.claude/settings.json`; every other key of the file, and its order, shall stay as it was, written with 2-space indent and a final newline, through `<file>.tmp` and `rename`; when the file is a symlink it shall write through to its target and leave the link in place; it shall answer the new list (K1–K4). One test holds every clause. src/main/skills/skills.test.ts set}
- {**K14** If the file to write is not valid JSON or not an object, or its `skillOverrides`/`enabledPlugins` exists and is not an object, or the item is `atril` or `plugin` origin (a plugin is switched whole), or its `lockedBy` (computed with the call's repoId) is set, or the state is not one of K3's four, then main shall reject (and `atril:skills:reveal` shall reject an `atril` item) naming the file or the reason and leave every file byte-identical. src/main/skills/skills.test.ts set}
- {**K15** When the person opens a `personal` or `project` item's detail (K7), the panel shall show «Estado» with «Activa», «Solo el nombre», «Solo si la llamas tú» and «Apagada» (the current one picked); picking another shall call `atril:skills:set` and, when it answers, show the new state on the card and «Hecho. Las sesiones nuevas de Claude Code ya lo cargan así.», plus «También cambia {n} más con el mismo nombre.» when other personal or project items share the name and read the same file; each plugin bar shall have a switch «Activo» doing the same with `enabledPlugins`; with `lockedBy` the control shall be disabled with «Lo fija {file}»; an `atril` item shall have no control. One test holds every clause. src/renderer/skills/skills.test.tsx state}
- {**K18** While a write (K13) is pending, the repo selector shall be disabled, so the answer for one repo never lands under another (K11). src/renderer/skills/skills.test.tsx the}
- {**K16** While `skillsWriteOk` is not set in Atril's state, when the person changes a state or a plugin switch, the screen shall first show the dialog «Atril va a cambiar tus ajustes de Claude Code» with `writesTo`, the key (`skillOverrides.{name}` or `enabledPlugins.{plugin}`) and the value, «Cambiar», «Cancelar» and «No volver a preguntar»; «Cancelar» or Escape shall write nothing and leave the control as it was; «Cambiar» shall write; with the box ticked it shall also store `skillsWriteOk: true`, after which no dialog shall show. One test holds every clause. src/renderer/skills/skills.test.tsx the}
- {**K17** If `atril:skills:set` rejects, then the screen shall show the `Problem` «No he podido cambiar tus ajustes de Claude Code.» with «Ver en Finder» (calls `atril:skills:reveal` with the item, which shows `writesTo` in Finder, or its folder when the file does not exist) and the error in its detail, and the control shall show the state it had. One test holds every clause. src/renderer/skills/skills.test.tsx a}
- {**K19** When `atril:skills:save` is called with `{ path, repoId?, base, text, force?, allowBroken? }` where `path` is a listed `personal` or `project` item's `path`, main shall answer in this order — if the file no longer equals `base` and `force` is not set, answer `{ conflict: true, disk }` (the file's current text) and write nothing; else if `text`'s header is broken by K2 or missing (first line not `---`) and `allowBroken` is not set, answer `{ brokenHeader: true }` and write nothing; else write `text` to that file (through `realpath`, via `.tmp` and `rename`) and answer `{ list }` with the new list. One test holds every clause. src/main/skills/skills.test.ts save}
- {**K20** If `atril:skills:save` or `atril:skills:read` gets a `path` that is not exactly a listed `personal` or `project` item's `path`, or one not under `claudeDir()` or the repo's `.claude` as listed, or (save) a `text` over 256 KB, or (read) a file over 256 KB, then main shall reject saying why and leave every file byte-identical. src/main/skills/skills.test.ts save}
- {**K26** When `atril:skills:read` is called with a listed `personal` or `project` item's `path` and `repoId?`, main shall answer the whole file's text, header included. src/main/skills/skills.test.ts read}
- {**K21** When `atril:skills:create` is called with `origin` (`personal` or `project`), `repoId?` and a `name` matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$`, main shall create `claudeDir()/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (personal) or `<repo>/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (project) holding `---\nname: <name>\ndescription: \n---\n\n` (`wx`, folders created) and answer the new list; if the name does not match, a skill with that name already exists in that origin or its folder exists, or a `project` create has no known repo, it shall reject and create nothing. One test holds every clause. src/main/skills/skills.test.ts create}
- {**K22** When the person opens a `personal` or `project` item's detail, the panel shall offer «Editar», which reads the file (K26) and shows it in a monospaced text area labelled «Texto de {name}» with «Guardar» (also ⌘S) and «Descartar»; «Guardar» shall call `atril:skills:save` and, on `{ list }`, show the item at the same `path` (with its new name if the header changed it) read-only and «Guardado.»; while saving, the repo selector shall be disabled; a `plugin` or `atril` item shall offer no «Editar»; a read rejection shall show «Es demasiado grande para editarla aquí.» or the error and keep the panel read-only. One test holds every clause. src/renderer/skills/skills.test.tsx edit}
- {**K23** When the save answers `{ conflict: true, disk }`, the panel shall say «Este archivo ha cambiado fuera de Atril.» with «Cargar el de disco» (text and `base` become `disk`) and «Guardar el mío encima» (saves again with `force`); when it answers `{ brokenHeader: true }`, it shall ask «La cabecera no se entiende: Claude Code puede ignorar esta skill.» with «Guardar igual» (saves again with `allowBroken`, keeping any `force`) and «Seguir editando»; any rejection shall show the `Problem` «No he podido guardar la skill.» with the error in its detail and keep the text. One test holds every clause. src/renderer/skills/skills.test.tsx a}
- {**K24** While the editor holds text different from `base`, when the person presses Escape, «Cerrar», «Descartar», activates another card or changes repo, the screen shall ask «Tienes cambios sin guardar. ¿Descartarlos?» with «Descartar cambios» and «Seguir editando», and leave the editor only on «Descartar cambios»; with no changes it shall leave without asking; when the person leaves the Skills screen instead, the text shall be kept in memory per `path` and, on opening that item's «Editar» again in the same run, come back with «Tienes cambios sin guardar de antes.». One test holds every clause. src/renderer/skills/skills.test.tsx leaving}
- {**K25** When the person activates «Nueva skill» in Personal or Proyecto, a dialog shall ask «Nombre» (with the rule «Minúsculas, números y guiones.» shown) and «Crear»; «Crear» shall be disabled while the name does not match K21; on success the new skill's detail shall open in «Editar»; a rejection shall show its reason in the dialog. One test holds every clause. src/renderer/skills/skills.test.tsx new}
- {**K27** When `atril:skills:catalog(repoId?)` is called, main shall run `claude plugin list --available --json` (working directory: the repo's path when `repoId` is known) and answer `{ catalog: { installed, available } }` from the JSON on the last line of stdout, each installed entry with `pluginId`, `scope` and `projectPath` when present, each available entry with `pluginId` (`name@marketplace`), `name`, `marketplace`, `description` and `version` when present. src/main/skills/plugins.test.ts the}

- {**I1** When the inbox refreshes, Atril shall call `GET /rest/api/3/search/jql` once with the JQL in Constraints. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts queries}

- {**I5** When the dialog opens, Atril shall propose the issue key exactly as Jira gives it (`WEB-3535`) as the branch name. src/main/jira/start.test.ts proposes}
- {**I6** When Start is confirmed, Atril shall launch `claude` with the bundled Libretto plugin, its hooks and the prompt `/libretto:libretto-flow <KEY>` in the new workspace's agent session — the plugin-namespaced name observed in box 4, because the bare `/libretto-flow` exists only where Libretto is installed globally. src/main/jira/start.test.ts start}
- {**I7** If an issue key does not match `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$`, then Atril shall refuse to start it. src/main/jira/start.test.ts refuses}

- {**I9** While a workspace record carries a task's key, the inbox shall show that workspace instead of Start, also after a restart. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts task}
- {**I10** If the proposed branch already exists in the repo, or its worktree path exists, then the dialog shall say so and propose the key with the first free letter suffix: `B`, `C`, `D`… (`WEB-3535B`), as the team does. src/main/jira/start.test.ts proposes}
- {**I11** When the inbox shows tasks, Atril shall group them: status category `new` → Por empezar; `indeterminate` whose status name says in progress → En curso; any other `indeterminate` → En revisión y despliegue, folded by default. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts groups}
- {**I12** While the Trabajo screen is shown, the sidebar shall show the running work first and the Jira tasks only as a one-line summary of counts that opens the Tareas screen. src/renderer/inbox/inbox.test.ts sidebar}

(One proof holds both promises: main computes the order and the filtering in one pass, and the test asserts both on one result.) src/main/jira/board.test.ts groups}
- {**I14** If a task's status is in no column of the picked board, then it shall go to «Fuera del tablero», after every column, folded. src/main/jira/board.test.ts tasks}
- {**I15** While no board is picked, the Tareas screen shall keep the status-category groups and show «Elige tu tablero en Ajustes para ver sus columnas» with a link to Ajustes. src/renderer/inbox/inbox.test.ts no}
- {**I16** If the board id is not a positive integer, then Atril shall refuse it before any request. src/main/jira/board.test.ts refuses}
- {**I17** While a board is picked, the sidebar summary shall count the first column's tasks as "por empezar" and the tasks of every other column as "en curso" («Fuera del tablero» counts in neither). src/renderer/inbox/inbox.test.ts summary}
- {**I18** If reading the picked board fails, then the inbox shall fall back to the status-category groups and show «No puedo leer el tablero: {W150 sentence}» with the W150 detail folded. src/main/jira/board.test.ts board}
- {**I19** Whether or not a board is picked, the inbox shall list only issues from the search with `assignee = currentUser()`, and shall never request the board's own issues. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts only}

- {**I22** When the person writes a task in «Nueva tarea», picks a repo and presses Empezar, Atril shall open a workspace on the shown branch with the chosen model, passing the text as the task with agent `claude`, and show it in Trabajo. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts own}
- {**I23** While the dialog is «Nueva tarea» and the text is empty or only spaces, Empezar shall be disabled; in both dialogs the text area shall accept at most 2000 characters. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts own}
- {**I25** If no repo is registered, then the dialog shall say «Añade un repo en Ajustes → Repos», offer «Ir a Ajustes» which closes the dialog and shows Ajustes, and Empezar shall be disabled. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts own}
- {**I26** While Jira is not connected (I3), «Nueva tarea» shall still be shown and open the dialog. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts own}
- {**I24** While the person has not edited the branch, the branch shall be the first five words of the text, a word being a run of `[a-z0-9]` after lower-casing and removing accents, joined by hyphens, at most 40 characters with no trailing hyphen («Añadir filtro de Laboratorios» → `anadir-filtro-de-laboratorios`; «fix: bug-in api, ya» → `fix-bug-in-api-ya`); once the person changes the field in any way, it shall stay as they left it. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts branch}
- {**I27** When the person starts from «Nuevo trabajo», Atril shall open the workspace with the text as its task when the text is not blank (as I22), and with no task — plain Claude — when it is blank; Empezar needs only a repo and a branch there. (One proof holds both: the test starts one with text and one without and checks each call.) src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts new}
- {**I29** While Jira is connected and reading the tasks fails (including a 401 or 403), Tareas shall show the W150 problem with «No puedo enseñarte tus tareas.» under it, its button («Volver a comprobar» reads again; «Abrir Ajustes» opens Ajustes) and the detail folded — never «Conecta Jira en Ajustes», which stays for Jira not connected. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts a}
- {**I30** (amends what I22 and I27 call «the text»: from here it is the composed text below) While the text of «Nueva tarea» or «Nuevo trabajo» is not blank, the dialog shall show a folded `<details>` «Afinar la petición · opcional»; opened, it shall hold four fields — «¿Qué tiene que pasar cuando esté hecho?», «¿Qué no entra?», «¿Dónde se toca? (pantalla, archivos)», «Un ejemplo». The composed text shall be the request as typed, then — only if any answer (fixed or Claude's, I31) is filled — a blank line and one line per filled answer: the fixed ones first, in that order, as «Hecho cuando: …», «No entra: …», «Dónde: …», «Ejemplo: …», then Claude's (I31). Every answer shall be trimmed with inner newlines turned into spaces; blank ones add nothing. While the text is blank the section shall be hidden and nothing of it sent (I27 opens plain Claude), its answers kept in the dialog. Empezar shall send the composed text, and the «Lanza» line shall show the template with the composed text in place of «tu texto» whenever the text is not blank. The `<details>` summary shall add «1 respuesta añadida» or «{n} respuestas añadidas», n counting fixed and Claude's filled answers, and nothing at 0. src/renderer/inbox/refine.test.tsx the}
- {**I31** When the person presses «Que Claude me pregunte» with text written, the dialog shall call `refine.ask(text)` once, show «Pensando…» with the button disabled while it waits, then one field per returned question under «Claude pregunta, sobre tu petición»; each filled one shall add «{pregunta} {respuesta}» after the fixed lines, cleaned as I30. Claude's questions stay when the request is edited. The button shall then read «Volver a preguntar», and pressing it shall replace Claude's questions and their answers, keeping the fixed ones. With blank text the button shall not exist (I30), and no other action of the dialog shall call `refine.ask`. src/renderer/inbox/refine.test.tsx claude}
- {**I32** If `refine.ask` answers an error, then the section shall show a `Problem` with that sentence, its `detail` folded, «Puedes empezar igual: afinar es opcional.» and «Volver a intentar», which asks again; Empezar shall stay usable. src/renderer/inbox/refine.test.tsx a}
- {**I33** While the request with its answers is longer than 2000 characters, Empezar shall be disabled and the dialog shall say «Con las respuestas pasa de 2000 caracteres: acorta algo.». src/renderer/inbox/refine.test.tsx a}
- {**I34** When Enter is pressed in a field of the section, focus shall move to the next field of the section (from the last, to «Que Claude me pregunte»), and nothing shall start; ⌘↩ shall still start (I22). src/renderer/inbox/refine.test.tsx enter}
